classification_audit.abstract: ABSTRACT The amyloid cascade involving the production and deposition of amyloid β (Aβ) peptides derived from amyloid precursor protein (APP) is a leading hypothesis in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, disease‐modifying therapies targeting this cascade remain an unmet challenge. Here, we identify small molecules that degrade APP and reduce Aβ production through a targeted protein degradation strategy. Using genetically engineered APP cell models and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)‐derived neurons from patients with AD, we demonstrate that cytoplasmic activation/proliferation‐associated protein 1 (CAPRIN1) is expressed in neurons and physically interacts with APP. Screening of a CAPRIN1‐targeted compound library identified compound 0043, which promotes intracellular APP degradation and reduces extracellular Aβ release. Structure–activity relationship optimization of 0043 derivatives yielded compound 0152 with improved potency and blood–brain barrier permeability. In AD iPSC‐derived neurons, these compounds enhance CAPRIN1–APP interactions and promote CAPRIN1‐dependent APP degradation through the endolysosomal pathway. CAPRIN1 is predominantly expressed in neurons in AD postmortem brains and iPSC‐derived brain organoids. Systemic administration of compound 0152 significantly reduced APP levels, Aβ production, and amyloid burden in 5xFAD mice. These findings establish CAPRIN1‐dependent, lysosome‐targeted molecular glue degraders as a potential APP‐targeted therapeutic strategy for AD. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease, amyloid precursor protein, amyloid β plaque, induced pluripotent stem cell, molecule glue degrader

items.action: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进展性神经退行性疾病，是全球范围内的痴呆症主要病因。AD的特征是细胞外β淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）积累和细胞内超磷酸化tau蛋白聚集，主要发生在大脑皮层和海马体。Aβ肽通过APP在神经元中被β-分泌酶1（BACE1）和γ-分泌酶依次切割生成，并在外周释放和聚集形成斑块，这是驱动下游tau病理、神经炎症和神经元损失的初始事件。大多数Aβ为40个残基长（Aβ40），但一小部分较长的Aβ42高度疏水性，容易积累并形成外周斑块。针对这一APP-淀粉样级联的治疗策略已开发出多种疾病修饰药物，包括BACE1和γ-分泌酶抑制剂以及靶向Aβ的单克隆抗体（mAbs）。尽管分泌酶抑制剂未能显示临床疗效，但如阿杜卡奈、莱可美和多纳美等mAbs已被FDA批准用于早期AD患者，凸显了针对APP衍生Aβ淀粉样蛋白的治疗潜力。CAPRIN1是一种在神经元中高表达的RNA结合蛋白，参与神经发育和神经退行性病变。CAPRIN1与APP相互作用并介导其向内吞噬-溶酶体途径的降解。通过细胞基筛选发现，CAPRIN1靶向分子胶（molecular glue）可增强CAPRIN1-APP相互作用，促进CAPRIN1介导的APP溶酶体降解。化合物0043在AD衍生iPSC神经元中显著降低APP和Aβ释放，其机制涉及CAPRIN1与APP的相互作用增强。通过结构-活性关系研究优化后，化合物0152表现出更高的效力、溶解性和血脑屏障渗透性。这些发现表明，CAPRIN1依赖的溶酶体靶向分子胶可作为AD治疗策略。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即CAPRIN1通过与APP相互作用促进其在内体-溶酶体途径中的降解。首先，通过细胞模型筛选发现化合物0043可增强CAPRIN1与APP的相互作用并促进APP降解。随后，通过结构-活性关系优化得到更有效的化合物0152，其具有更好的溶解性和血脑屏障渗透性。进一步验证显示，0152在AD iPSC神经元中显著减少APP和Aβ42水平，并且其作用机制涉及CAPRIN1与APP的直接相互作用。综述分析通过比较不同实验数据，确认了化合物对APP降解的促进作用及CAPRIN1在其中的关键角色。这些步骤对于验证假说、排除替代解释以及确定治疗策略至关重要。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，CAPRIN1通过增强与APP的相互作用促进其在内体-溶酶体途径中的降解，这一机制可作为靶向APP的治疗策略。该实验设计表明，针对特定蛋白相互作用的分子胶降解剂能有效调控目标蛋白的稳态，适用于其他神经退行性疾病中类似蛋白相互作用的调控。此原则的适用边界在于需明确目标蛋白的功能及相互作用网络。
items.selection_reason: 本文研究发现CAPRIN1依赖的分子胶降解剂可增强APP在溶酶体中的降解，从而减少Aβ释放。该策略通过靶向CAPRIN1与APP的相互作用界面，促进其结合并加速APP的溶酶体降解。化合物0152表现出更高的活性、溶解性和血脑屏障渗透性，能够有效降低AD患者iPSC衍生神经元中的APP和Aβ42水平。研究证实了CAPRIN1在APP稳态中的重要作用，并揭示了一种新的溶酶体定向分子胶策略，为AD治疗提供了潜在的靶向方法。
items.application_prospects: 本文研究了CAPRIN1依赖的分子胶降解剂在阿尔茨海默病中的应用前景。通过筛选化合物，发现0043和0152可增强CAPRIN1与APP的相互作用，促进APP在内体-溶酶体途径中的降解，减少Aβ42积累。这些化合物在AD iPSC神经元中表现出良好的效果，并能显著降低APP水平和Aβ生产。然而，其应用仍受限于血脑屏障渗透性和溶度问题。未来需进一步优化药物特性以实现临床转化。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索CAPRIN1靶向分子胶结合物在不同AD亚型中的疗效差异，以及其对神经元功能的长期影响。此外，应验证这些化合物在其他神经退行性疾病中的潜在应用，并优化其血脑屏障渗透性以提高治疗效果。

fields.en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that is the leading cause of dementia worldwide. The hallmark of AD is the extracellular accumulation of beta-amyloid (Aβ) and intracellular hyperphosphorylated tau protein aggregates, primarily occurring in the cerebral cortex and hippocampus. Aβ peptides are generated in neurons through sequential cleavage by β-secretase 1 (BACE1) and γ-secretase from APP, and are then released peripherally and aggregate to form plaques, which represent the initial events driving downstream tau pathology, neuroinflammation, and neuronal loss. Most Aβ are 40 residues long (Aβ40), but a small fraction of longer Aβ42 is highly hydrophobic, prone to accumulation, and forms peripheral plaques. Therapeutic strategies targeting the APP-amyloid cascade have developed multiple disease-modifying drugs, including BACE1 and γ-secretase inhibitors as well as monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) targeting Aβ. Although secretase inhibitors failed to show clinical efficacy, mAbs such as aducanib, lecanemab, and donanemab have been FDA-approved for early AD patients, highlighting the therapeutic potential of targeting APP-derived amyloid beta proteins. CAPRIN1 is an RNA-binding protein highly expressed in neurons, involved in neurodevelopment and neurodegenerative diseases. CAPRIN1 interacts with APP and mediates its degradation via the endocytic-lysosomal pathway. Through cell-based screening, it was found that CAPRIN1-targeted molecular glues (molecular glues) can enhance the interaction between CAPRIN1 and APP, promoting CAPRIN1-mediated APP lysosomal degradation. Compound 0043 significantly reduces APP and Aβ release in AD-derived iPSC neurons, with mechanisms involving enhanced interaction between CAPRIN1 and APP. After optimization through structure-activity relationship studies, compound 0152 exhibits higher efficacy, solubility, and blood-brain barrier permeability. These findings suggest that CAPRIN1-dependent lysosomal-targeted molecular glues can serve as a therapeutic strategy for AD.

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis that CAPRIN1 promotes the degradation of APP in the endosome-lysosomal pathway by interacting with APP. First, through cell model screening, it was found that compound 0043 enhances the interaction between CAPRIN1 and APP and promotes APP degradation. Subsequently, through structure-activity relationship optimization, a more effective compound 0152 was obtained, which has better solubility and blood-brain barrier permeability. Further verification showed that 0152 significantly reduces APP and Aβ42 levels in AD iPSC neurons, and its mechanism of action involves direct interaction between CAPRIN1 and APP. The review analysis confirmed the promoting effect of the compounds on APP degradation and the key role of CAPRIN1 in this process by comparing different experimental data. These steps are crucial for validating the hypothesis, excluding alternative explanations, and determining treatment strategies.

fields.en: My conclusion is that CAPRIN1 promotes the degradation of APP in the endosome-lysosomal pathway by enhancing its interaction with APP, and this mechanism can serve as a therapeutic strategy targeting APP. The experimental design indicates that molecular glues targeting specific protein interactions can effectively regulate the homeostasis of target proteins, making them applicable for the modulation of similar protein interactions in other neurodegenerative diseases. The limitations of this principle lie in the need to clearly define the functions of the target protein and its interaction network.

fields.en: This study found that a molecular gluteal degrader dependent on CAPRIN1 can enhance the degradation of APP in lysosomes, thereby reducing the release of Aβ. This strategy targets the interaction interface between CAPRIN1 and APP, promoting their binding and accelerating the lysosomal degradation of APP. Compound 0152 showed higher activity, solubility, and blood-brain barrier permeability, effectively lowering the levels of APP and Aβ42 in iPSC-derived neurons of AD patients. The study confirmed the important role of CAPRIN1 in the homeostasis of APP and revealed a new lysosomal-targeted molecular gluteal strategy, providing a potential targeted approach for the treatment of AD.

fields.en: This study explores the potential application of CAPRIN1-dependent molecular glues in Alzheimer's disease. Through compound screening, it was found that compounds 0043 and 0152 can enhance the interaction between CAPRIN1 and APP, promoting the degradation of APP via the endosome-lysosomal pathway and reducing the accumulation of Aβ42. These compounds show good effects in AD iPSC neurons and significantly lower APP levels and Aβ production. However, their application is still limited by issues of permeability through the blood-brain barrier and solubility. Future work needs to further optimize drug properties to achieve clinical translation.
fields.zh: 本文研究了CAPRIN1依赖的分子胶降解剂在阿尔茨海默病中的应用前景。通过筛选化合物，发现0043和0152可增强CAPRIN1与APP的相互作用，促进APP在内体-溶酶体途径中的降解，减少Aβ42积累。这些化合物在AD iPSC神经元中表现出良好的效果，并能显著降低APP水平和Aβ生产。然而，其应用仍受限于血脑屏障渗透性和溶度问题。未来需进一步优化药物特性以实现临床转化。

decisions.focus: Transfer hydrogenation of NAD+ in cancer cells using organometallic complexes as a novel approach for anticancer drug design

This study presents a novel approach to anticancer drug design by utilizing organometallic complexes for catalytic hydrogenation within cancer cells, demonstrating the ability of these complexes to modulate the redox status of cancer cells through reductive stress. The research shows that Ru(II) sulfonamido ethyleneamine complexes can effectively reduce NAD+ to NADH in human ovarian cancer cells using formate as a hydride donor, with enhanced catalytic activity and selectivity towards cancer cells compared to normal cells. This mechanism of cell death via reductive stress is distinct from oxidative stress mechanisms observed with iridium catalysts. The study provides experimental evidence supporting the use of organometallic complexes in targeting redox status modulation for anticancer applications.

classification_audit.abstract: Organometallic complexes are effective hydrogenation catalysts for organic reactions. For example, Noyori-type ruthenium complexes catalyse reduction of ketones by transfer of hydride from formate. Here we show that such catalytic reactions can be achieved in cancer cells, offering a new strategy for the design of safe metal-based anticancer drugs. The activity of ruthenium(II) sulfonamido ethyleneamine complexes towards human ovarian cancer cells is enhanced by up to 50 × in the presence of low non-toxic doses of formate. The extent of conversion of coenzyme NAD + to NADH in cells is dependent on formate concentration. This novel reductive stress mechanism of cell death does not involve apoptosis or perturbation of mitochondrial membrane potentials. In contrast, iridium cyclopentadienyl catalysts cause cancer cell death by oxidative stress. Organometallic complexes therefore have an extraordinary ability to modulate the redox status of cancer cells.

items.action:
有机金属复合物在细胞内催化反应的潜力为抗癌药物设计提供了新思路。研究显示，Ru(II)硫代氨基乙基胺复合物能在低毒浓度的甲酸存在下，在人卵巢癌细胞中催化还原辅酶NAD+，且催化活性显著增强，选择性更高。这种通过还原应激导致的细胞死亡机制不同于铱催化剂引发的氧化应激。实验表明，Ru(II)复合物在细胞内催化反应的效率受硫代氨基取代基和芳香环的影响，其中甲酸作为氢供体，在不同浓度下对NAD+转化为NADH的程度有显著影响。此外，通过流式细胞术检测发现，与甲酸共同作用时，Ru(II)复合物诱导的细胞死亡不涉及凋亡或线粒体膜电位扰动。研究还显示，Ru(II)复合物在细胞内能调节红ox状态，这为开发新型抗癌药物提供了理论基础和实验依据。

本研究通过对比不同Ru(II)复合物与甲酸的组合使用效果，发现其对卵巢癌细胞的抑制作用显著增强。同时，Ru(II)复合物在细胞内的积累和分布也显示出良好的生物利用性。NAD+/NADH比值的变化进一步证实了这种还原应激机制的有效性。实验还表明，Ru(II)复合物与甲酸共同使用时，对细胞的毒性作用显著降低，且不影响细胞膜完整性。

综上所述，有机金属复合物在细胞内催化反应的能力为抗癌药物设计提供了新途径。通过调控红ox状态，Ru(II)复合物能够选择性地影响癌细胞代谢，从而实现高效、低毒的抗癌效果。这种基于还原应激的新机制为开发安全有效的抗癌药物提供了理论支持和实验依据。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即有机金属复合物可以在细胞内催化反应，并通过转移氢化作用影响癌细胞的红ox状态。首先，作者比较了不同Ru II复合物在细胞内的催化活性，发现其对NAD+的还原能力与形式酸浓度有关。随后，通过实验验证了Ru II复合物在细胞内催化还原NAD+的能力，并排除了其他可能的机制，如凋亡或线粒体膜电位扰动。作者进一步比较了不同复合物的催化效率和选择性，发现Ru II复合物在癌细胞中表现出更高的活性和选择性。此外，通过分析NAD+/NADH比值的变化，确认了还原应激是细胞死亡的主要机制。综述分析则通过比较不同实验条件下的数据，验证了Ru II复合物的催化效果，并排除了其他可能的解释。这些步骤对于确保实验结果的可靠性和科学性至关重要。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过细胞内催化反应调控癌细胞的氧化还原状态，提出了一种新的抗癌药物设计策略。实验表明，Ru II 催化剂在细胞内可有效将NAD+转化为NADH，这种还原应激机制不同于传统氧化应激途径。该机制的可迁移性在于：利用金属配合物在细胞内催化反应来调控红ox状态，适用于其他需要调控细胞代谢的疾病治疗，但需注意其对细胞膜完整性的影响。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过细胞内转移氢化催化揭示了金属有机复合物调控癌细胞红ox状态的新机制。Ru(II)硫代氨基乙基胺复合物在低毒浓度formate作用下，可显著增强对卵巢癌细胞的催化活性，且选择性高于正常细胞。这种由还原应激引发的细胞死亡机制不同于传统氧化应激途径，表明金属有机复合物具有独特调控细胞红ox平衡的能力。实验通过NMR和流式细胞术证实了该机制的有效性，并展示了Ru复合物在细胞内积累及NAD+/NADH比值变化的动态过程。研究证明，这种新型催化策略可为设计安全有效的抗肿瘤药物提供新思路，其优势在于避免传统铂类药物耐药问题，且不依赖已知 apoptosis 或线粒体膜电位扰动机制。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了有机金属复合物在细胞内催化反应中的应用前景，特别是在癌症治疗中的潜力。通过利用Ru(II)硫代氨基乙基胺复合物与甲酸作为氢转移剂，在癌细胞中实现NAD+的还原，从而调节细胞内的氧化还原状态。该方法具有低毒性和高选择性，能够有效杀伤癌细胞而不影响正常细胞。然而，其应用仍受限于细胞内复杂的生物环境和催化反应条件的控制。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索Ru II 催化剂与formate在细胞内的协同作用机制，以及其对不同癌细胞系的特异性。此外，应验证该红ox调节是否能通过调控NAD+/NADH比例影响肿瘤生长，并设计更高效的催化剂以提高抗癌效果。

fields.en:
The potential of organometallic complexes to catalyze reactions within cells has provided new insights for the design of anticancer drugs. Studies show that Ru(II) thioaminomethyl complex can catalyze the reduction of coenzyme NAD+ in human ovarian cancer cells in the presence of formic acid at low toxic concentrations, with significantly enhanced catalytic activity and higher selectivity. This mechanism of cell death induced by reduction stress is different from that caused by iridium catalysts inducing oxidative stress. Experiments indicate that the efficiency of Ru(II) complexes in catalyzing reactions within cells is affected by the thioaminomethyl substituent and aromatic ring, where formic acid acts as a hydrogen donor, significantly influencing the extent to which NAD+ is converted to NADH under different concentrations. Furthermore, flow cytometry analysis revealed that when Ru(II) complexes act in conjunction with formic acid, the induced cell death does not involve apoptosis or mitochondrial membrane potential disturbance. The study also showed that Ru(II) complexes can regulate redox status within cells, providing a theoretical basis and experimental evidence for the development of new anticancer drugs.

This study, by comparing the effects of different Ru(II) complexes with formic acid, found significant enhancement in the inhibition of ovarian cancer cells. At the same time, the accumulation and distribution of Ru(II) complexes within cells also demonstrated good bioavailability. Changes in the NAD+/NADH ratio further confirmed the effectiveness of this reduction stress mechanism. Experiments also showed that when Ru(II) complexes are used together with formic acid, the toxicity to cells is significantly reduced, and it does not affect cell membrane integrity.

In conclusion, the ability of organometallic complexes to catalyze reactions within cells provides a new pathway for the design of anticancer drugs. By regulating redox status, Ru(II) complexes can selectively affect the metabolism of cancer cells, achieving efficient and low-toxicity anticancer effects. This new mechanism based on reduction stress provides theoretical support and experimental evidence for the development of safe and effective anticancer drugs.

本研究通过对比不同Ru(II)复合物与甲酸的组合使用效果，发现其对卵巢癌细胞的抑制作用显著增强。同时，Ru(II)复合物在细胞内的积累和分布也显示出良好的生物利用性。NAD+/NADH比值的变化进一步证实了这种还原应激机制的有效性。实验还表明，Ru(II)复合物与甲酸共同使用时，对细胞的毒性作用显著降低，且不影响细胞膜完整性。

综上所述，有机金属复合物在细胞内催化反应的能力为抗癌药物设计提供了新途径。通过调控红ox状态，Ru(II)复合物能够选择性地影响癌细胞代谢，从而实现高效、低毒的抗癌效果。这种基于还原应激的新机制为开发安全有效的抗癌药物提供了理论支持和实验依据。

paragraphs.en: The potential of organometallic complexes to catalyze reactions within cells has provided new insights for the design of anticancer drugs. Studies show that Ru(II) thioaminomethyl complex can catalyze the reduction of coenzyme NAD+ in human ovarian cancer cells in the presence of formic acid at low toxic concentrations, with significantly enhanced catalytic activity and higher selectivity. This mechanism of cell death induced by reduction stress is different from that caused by iridium catalysts inducing oxidative stress. Experiments indicate that the efficiency of Ru(II) complexes in catalyzing reactions within cells is affected by the thioaminomethyl substituent and aromatic ring, where formic acid acts as a hydrogen donor, significantly influencing the extent to which NAD+ is converted to NADH under different concentrations. Furthermore, flow cytometry analysis revealed that when Ru(II) complexes act in conjunction with formic acid, the induced cell death does not involve apoptosis or mitochondrial membrane potential disturbance. The study also showed that Ru(II) complexes can regulate redox status within cells, providing a theoretical basis and experimental evidence for the development of new anticancer drugs.

paragraphs.en: This study, by comparing the effects of different Ru(II) complexes with formic acid, found significant enhancement in the inhibition of ovarian cancer cells. At the same time, the accumulation and distribution of Ru(II) complexes within cells also demonstrated good bioavailability. Changes in the NAD+/NADH ratio further confirmed the effectiveness of this reduction stress mechanism. Experiments also showed that when Ru(II) complexes are used together with formic acid, the toxicity to cells is significantly reduced, and it does not affect cell membrane integrity.

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, the ability of organometallic complexes to catalyze reactions within cells provides a new pathway for the design of anticancer drugs. By regulating redox status, Ru(II) complexes can selectively affect the metabolism of cancer cells, achieving efficient and low-toxicity anticancer effects. This new mechanism based on reduction stress provides theoretical support and experimental evidence for the development of safe and effective anticancer drugs.

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis that organometallic complexes can catalyze reactions within cells and influence the redox state of cancer cells through hydrogen transfer. First, the authors compared the catalytic activity of different Ru(II) complexes in cells, finding that their ability to reduce NAD+ is related to the concentration of formic acid. Subsequently, experiments verified the ability of Ru(II) complexes to catalyze the reduction of NAD+ within cells, and excluded other possible mechanisms such as apoptosis or mitochondrial membrane potential perturbations. The authors further compared the catalytic efficiency and selectivity of different complexes, finding that Ru(II) complexes showed higher activity and selectivity in cancer cells. Additionally, by analyzing changes in the NAD+/NADH ratio, it was confirmed that reduction stress is the primary mechanism of cell death. The review analysis verified the catalytic effect of Ru(II) complexes by comparing data under different experimental conditions and excluded other possible explanations. These steps are crucial for ensuring the reliability and scientific validity of the experimental results.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说，即有机金属复合物可以在细胞内催化反应，并通过转移氢化作用影响癌细胞的红ox状态。首先，作者比较了不同Ru II复合物在细胞内的催化活性，发现其对NAD+的还原能力与形式酸浓度有关。随后，通过实验验证了Ru II复合物在细胞内催化还原NAD+的能力，并排除了其他可能的机制，如凋亡或线粒体膜电位扰动。作者进一步比较了不同复合物的催化效率和选择性，发现Ru II复合物在癌细胞中表现出更高的活性和选择性。此外，通过分析NAD+/NADH比值的变化，确认了还原应激是细胞死亡的主要机制。综述分析则通过比较不同实验条件下的数据，验证了Ru II复合物的催化效果，并排除了其他可能的解释。这些步骤对于确保实验结果的可靠性和科学性至关重要。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study proposes a new anticancer drug design strategy by regulating the redox state of cancer cells through intracellular catalytic reactions. The experiments show that Ru II catalysts can effectively convert NAD+ to NADH inside cells, and this reduction stress mechanism differs from traditional oxidative stress pathways. The transferability of this mechanism lies in using metal complexes to catalyze reactions within cells to regulate redox states, which is applicable for the treatment of other diseases requiring regulation of cellular metabolism, but attention should be paid to its effects on cell membrane integrity.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过细胞内催化反应调控癌细胞的氧化还原状态，提出了一种新的抗癌药物设计策略。实验表明，Ru II 催化剂在细胞内可有效将NAD+转化为NADH，这种还原应激机制不同于传统氧化应激途径。该机制的可迁移性在于：利用金属配合物在细胞内催化反应来调控红ox状态，适用于其他需要调控细胞代谢的疾病治疗，但需注意其对细胞膜完整性的影响。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study reveals a new mechanism by which metal-organic complexes regulate the redox state of cancer cells through intracellular transfer hydrogenation catalysis. The ruthenium(II) thioaminomethyl complex significantly enhances catalytic activity toward ovarian cancer cells under low toxic concentration formate, with higher selectivity compared to normal cells. This cell death mechanism induced by reductive stress differs from traditional oxidative stress pathways, indicating the unique ability of metal-organic complexes to regulate cellular redox balance. The validity of this mechanism was confirmed through NMR and flow cytometry, demonstrating the dynamic process of Ru complex accumulation within cells and changes in the NAD+/NADH ratio. The study shows that this novel catalytic strategy provides new insights for designing safe and effective anticancer drugs, with advantages including avoiding the resistance issues associated with traditional platinum-based drugs and not relying on known apoptosis or mitochondrial membrane potential perturbation mechanisms.
fields.zh: 该研究通过细胞内转移氢化催化揭示了金属有机复合物调控癌细胞红ox状态的新机制。Ru(II)硫代氨基乙基胺复合物在低毒浓度formate作用下，可显著增强对卵巢癌细胞的催化活性，且选择性高于正常细胞。这种由还原应激引发的细胞死亡机制不同于传统氧化应激途径，表明金属有机复合物具有独特调控细胞红ox平衡的能力。实验通过NMR和流式细胞术证实了该机制的有效性，并展示了Ru复合物在细胞内积累及NAD+/NADH比值变化的动态过程。研究证明，这种新型催化策略可为设计安全有效的抗肿瘤药物提供新思路，其优势在于避免传统铂类药物耐药问题，且不依赖已知 apoptosis 或线粒体膜电位扰动机制。

fields.en: This paper explores the potential application of organometallic complexes in catalytic reactions within cells, particularly their potential in cancer therapy. By utilizing Ru(II) thioaminomethyl complex with formic acid as a hydrogen transfer agent, NAD+ can be reduced in cancer cells, thereby regulating the cellular redox state. The method exhibits low toxicity and high selectivity, effectively killing cancer cells without affecting normal cells. However, its application is still limited by the complex biological environment within cells and the control of catalytic reaction conditions.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了有机金属复合物在细胞内催化反应中的应用前景，特别是在癌症治疗中的潜力。通过利用Ru(II)硫代氨基乙基胺复合物与甲酸作为氢转移剂，在癌细胞中实现NAD+的还原，从而调节细胞内的氧化还原状态。该方法具有低毒性和高选择性，能够有效杀伤癌细胞而不影响正常细胞。然而，其应用仍受限于细胞内复杂的生物环境和催化反应条件的控制。

fields.en: Future research could further explore the synergistic mechanisms of Ru(II) catalysts with formate within cells, as well as their specificity toward different cancer cell lines. Additionally, it should be verified whether this redox regulation can affect tumor growth by modulating the NAD+/NADH ratio, and designs for more efficient catalysts should be developed to enhance anticancer efficacy.

decisions.focus: Moisture sorption and hydration dynamics in intrinsically hygroscopic hydrogels

This work presents a novel approach to designing hygroscopic hydrogels through pH-controlled supramolecular coordination, demonstrating how Zn-centered coordination environments influence moisture sorption and hydration dynamics. The study provides a mechanistic understanding of how network structure and coordination microenvironments modulate water uptake across different humidity regimes, offering insights into the design of salt-free hygroscopic materials with broad operational windows.

classification_audit.abstract: Hygroscopic materials that capture water vapor across a wide humidity range are important for emerging applications including atmospheric water harvesting, moisture control, and thermal management. Hydrogel sorbents are attractive because they can store large amounts of water while remaining solid-like, yet common hydrophilic gels sorb little vapor at low relative humidity (RH) unless hygroscopicity is introduced by deliquescent salts. Here, we report intrinsically hygroscopic hydrogels (IHHs) assembled from inosine and Zn 2+ through pH-controlled supramolecular coordination. The IHHs show a moisture-sorption onset near zero RH, reaching 0.17 g g −1 at 30% RH while retaining swelling-amplified uptake at high RH (1.9 g g −1 at 95% RH) and reversible cycling. Varying gelation pH reprograms the coordination microenvironment and network structure, reshaping early-stage sorption and shifting uptake onset. Experiments and simulations indicate that hydration-accessible Zn-centered motifs serve as important early hydration loci, while pH-dependent network structure further modulates hydration growth. These results provide a coordination-chemistry route to hygroscopic hydrogels without salt deliquescence.

items.action:
本研究开发了一种内在吸湿性水凝胶（IHHs），通过pH调控的分子自组装，利用inosine和Zn²+构建协调网络。该材料在低相对湿度下即可启动吸湿过程，在高湿度下仍能保持显著的吸湿能力，并且具有可逆循环特性。研究发现，Zn中心的协调环境作为早期水合位点，其pH依赖性调控影响了水合过程的起始和扩展。通过实验与模拟结合，揭示了协调网络如何动态调节水合生长。IHHs在不使用盐类脱水剂的情况下实现了吸湿性水凝胶的设计，为开发无盐脱水材料提供了新思路。

IHHs的制备依赖于pH调控的自组装过程，通过调整混合溶液的pH值，可控制协调网络的形成和结构演化。不同pH条件下的gels表现出不同的协调微环境和网络结构，这影响了早期水合位点的分布和水合过程的起始。研究发现，在低pH条件下，IHHs在低相对湿度下即可启动吸湿过程，并且在高湿度下仍能保持显著的吸湿能力。

通过动态水分吸附分析（DVS）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR），研究进一步揭示了协调微环境对水合动力学的影响。在低相对湿度下，IHHs主要吸收强氢键结合的水分子；随着湿度升高，弱氢键结合的水分子逐渐增加，并最终形成更扩展的氢键结构。这些结果表明，Zn中心的协调微环境作为重要的早期水合位点，在pH调控下动态调节着水合过程的发展。

综上所述，IHHs通过协调网络的设计和pH调控，实现了在不使用盐类脱水剂的情况下，对吸湿性水凝胶的开发。该研究为设计无盐脱水材料提供了新的思路，并揭示了协调化学在吸湿性水凝胶中的应用潜力。
items.research_logic: 作者通过pH调控的自组装构建了内在吸湿性水凝胶（IHHs），并利用实验与模拟分析其水分吸附动力学。通过调节pH值，改变了金属-配体协同网络结构，从而影响早期水分吸附位点的可接近性。在不同RH条件下，IHHs表现出不同的水分吸收行为，其中低pH条件下的IHHs在低RH下即可显著吸湿，并在高RH下保持持续吸湿。通过FTIR和SAXS分析发现，Zn中心的配位环境是早期水分吸附的关键部位，其结构动态变化影响了水分的结合方式与网络连接性。此外，通过改变Zn前驱体（硝酸盐→乙酸盐）验证了配位环境对水分吸附的影响，表明乙酸盐占据了部分Zn配位位置，从而抑制了早期吸附位点的可接近性。这些结果为设计无盐吸湿水凝胶提供了协调化学路径，并揭示了网络结构如何编码水分响应行为。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过pH调控的分子自组装构建了无需盐析的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs），其关键在于金属中心协调环境作为早期吸湿位点，并通过网络结构动态调节水分吸收行为。该设计原则可迁移至其他需要低相对湿度下启动吸湿的材料系统，但需注意协调环境与网络结构的耦合强度及pH调控范围限制。
items.selection_reason: 本文报道的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs）通过pH调控的分子自组装，实现了在低相对湿度下启动吸湿，并在高湿度下保持大容量吸附。该设计超越了传统流水线工作，通过金属配位环境调控水分吸附行为，无需引入盐类脱水剂即可实现宽湿度窗口内的吸湿性能。IHHs的吸湿起始点接近零RH，且在高RH下仍能维持显著的吸湿能力，同时具备可逆循环特性。这种设计基于协调化学原理，通过调节pH值控制配位微环境和网络结构，从而影响水分吸附动力学。实验与模拟结果表明，Zn中心的配位环境作为早期水合位点，其动态变化决定了水分在凝胶中的分布与演化。该研究为开发无盐类的吸湿水凝胶提供了新思路，并展示了如何通过分子层面的设计实现材料性能的优化。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs）通过pH调控的分子自组装，实现了在低相对湿度下启动吸湿，并在高湿度下保持大容量吸附。其核心在于Zn中心的配位环境作为早期吸湿位点，通过调节pH可控制网络结构和水分吸收行为。该材料无需盐类析出即可实现宽湿度范围内的吸湿性能，为无盐吸湿水凝胶的设计提供了新思路。
items.future_directions: 本文揭示了通过pH调控的金属-配体协同作用构建的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs）在湿度范围内的吸湿行为与动态演化机制。未来可进一步研究不同pH条件下的协调微环境对水分吸附动力学的影响，以及如何利用这些协调结构优化水凝胶的吸湿响应特性。此外，可通过分子动力学模拟探索Zn中心配位环境在早期吸湿过程中的作用机制，并验证其在实际应用中的稳定性与可重复性。

fields.en:
This study developed an intrinsically hygroscopic hydrogel (IHHs) through pH-controlled molecular self-assembly, using inosine and Zn²+ to construct a coordination network. The material can initiate the hygroscopic process at low relative humidity and maintains significant hygroscopic capacity even at high humidity, while also exhibiting reversible cyclic properties. The study found that the coordination environment around the Zn center acts as an early hydration site, and its pH-dependent regulation influences the initiation and expansion of the hydration process. Through experimental and simulation combined approaches, the dynamic regulation of hydration growth by the coordination network was revealed. IHHs achieved the design of hygroscopic hydrogels without using salt dehydration agents, providing new insights for the development of salt-free dehydration materials.

The preparation of IHHs relies on a self-assembly process regulated by pH, through adjusting the pH value of the mixed solution, the formation and structural evolution of the coordination network can be controlled. Gels under different pH conditions exhibit different coordination microenvironments and network structures, which affect the distribution of early hydration sites and the initiation of the hydration process. Research findings show that under low pH conditions, IHHs can initiate the hygroscopic process even at low relative humidity, and maintain significant hygroscopic capacity even under high humidity.

Studies using dynamic water sorption analysis (DVS) and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) further reveal the influence of coordination microenvironments on hydration kinetics. Under low relative humidity, IHHs primarily absorb strongly hydrogen-bonded water molecules; as humidity increases, weakly hydrogen-bonded water molecules gradually increase and ultimately form more extended hydrogen bond structures. These results indicate that the coordination microenvironment around the Zn center serves as an important early hydration site, dynamically regulating the development of the hydration process under pH control.

In summary, IHHs achieve the development of hygroscopic hydrogels without the use of salt-based dehydration agents by coordinating network design and pH regulation. This study provides new insights into designing salt-free dehydration materials and highlights the potential application of coordination chemistry in hygroscopic hydrogels.

paragraphs.zh: IHHs的制备依赖于pH调控的自组装过程，通过调整混合溶液的pH值，可控制协调网络的形成和结构演化。不同pH条件下的gels表现出不同的协调微环境和网络结构，这影响了早期水合位点的分布和水合过程的起始。研究发现，在低pH条件下，IHHs在低相对湿度下即可启动吸湿过程，并且在高湿度下仍能保持显著的吸湿能力。

paragraphs.en: Studies using dynamic water sorption analysis (DVS) and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) further reveal the influence of coordination microenvironments on hydration kinetics. Under low relative humidity, IHHs primarily absorb strongly hydrogen-bonded water molecules; as humidity increases, weakly hydrogen-bonded water molecules gradually increase and ultimately form more extended hydrogen bond structures. These results indicate that the coordination microenvironment around the Zn center serves as an important early hydration site, dynamically regulating the development of the hydration process under pH control.
paragraphs.zh: 通过动态水分吸附分析（DVS）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR），研究进一步揭示了协调微环境对水合动力学的影响。在低相对湿度下，IHHs主要吸收强氢键结合的水分子；随着湿度升高，弱氢键结合的水分子逐渐增加，并最终形成更扩展的氢键结构。这些结果表明，Zn中心的协调微环境作为重要的早期水合位点，在pH调控下动态调节着水合过程的发展。

paragraphs.en: In summary, IHHs achieve the development of hygroscopic hydrogels without the use of salt-based dehydration agents by coordinating network design and pH regulation. This study provides new insights into designing salt-free dehydration materials and highlights the potential application of coordination chemistry in hygroscopic hydrogels.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，IHHs通过协调网络的设计和pH调控，实现了在不使用盐类脱水剂的情况下，对吸湿性水凝胶的开发。该研究为设计无盐脱水材料提供了新的思路，并揭示了协调化学在吸湿性水凝胶中的应用潜力。

fields.en: The author constructed internally hygroscopic hydrogels (IHHs) through pH-controlled self-assembly and analyzed their water adsorption kinetics using experimental and simulation methods. By regulating the pH value, the metal-ligand synergistic network structure was altered, thereby affecting the accessibility of early water adsorption sites. Under different relative humidity (RH) conditions, IHHs exhibited distinct water absorption behaviors, with IHHs under low pH showing significant hygroscopicity even at low RH and maintaining continuous hygroscopicity at high RH. Through FTIR and SAXS analysis, it was found that the coordination environment of Zn is crucial for early water adsorption, and its structural dynamic changes influence the binding mode of water and network connectivity. Furthermore, by changing the Zn precursor (nitrate → acetate), the effect of the coordination environment on water adsorption was verified, indicating that acetate occupies part of the Zn coordination sites, thereby inhibiting the accessibility of early adsorption sites. These results provide a coordinated chemical pathway for designing salt-free hygroscopic hydrogels and reveal how network structure encodes water response behavior.
fields.zh: 作者通过pH调控的自组装构建了内在吸湿性水凝胶（IHHs），并利用实验与模拟分析其水分吸附动力学。通过调节pH值，改变了金属-配体协同网络结构，从而影响早期水分吸附位点的可接近性。在不同RH条件下，IHHs表现出不同的水分吸收行为，其中低pH条件下的IHHs在低RH下即可显著吸湿，并在高RH下保持持续吸湿。通过FTIR和SAXS分析发现，Zn中心的配位环境是早期水分吸附的关键部位，其结构动态变化影响了水分的结合方式与网络连接性。此外，通过改变Zn前驱体（硝酸盐→乙酸盐）验证了配位环境对水分吸附的影响，表明乙酸盐占据了部分Zn配位位置，从而抑制了早期吸附位点的可接近性。这些结果为设计无盐吸湿水凝胶提供了协调化学路径，并揭示了网络结构如何编码水分响应行为。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study constructed a non-salt-precipitation intrinsic hygroscopic hydrogel (IHHs) through pH-controlled molecular self-assembly, with the key being the metal center coordination environment as an early hygroscopic site and the dynamic regulation of water absorption behavior through the network structure. This design principle can be transferred to other material systems that require initiation of hygroscopy at low relative humidity, but attention should be paid to the coupling strength between the coordination environment and the network structure as well as the limitations of the pH control range.

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper reports on intrinsic hygroscopic hydrogels (IHHs) that achieve hygroscopic initiation at low relative humidity through pH-controlled molecular self-assembly, and maintain high-capacity adsorption at high humidity. The design surpasses traditional pipeline work by regulating water adsorption behavior through metal coordination environments without the need for salt desiccants. The hygroscopic starting point of IHHs is close to zero RH, and they can maintain significant hygroscopic capacity even at high RH, while also exhibiting reversible cyclic properties. This design is based on coordination chemistry principles, where pH values are regulated to control the coordination microenvironment and network structure, thereby influencing water adsorption kinetics. Experimental and simulation results show that the coordination environment around Zn centers serves as an early hydration site, and its dynamic changes determine the distribution and evolution of water within the hydrogel. This study provides new insights for developing salt-free hygroscopic hydrogels and demonstrates how molecular-level design can optimize material performance.
fields.zh: 本文报道的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs）通过pH调控的分子自组装，实现了在低相对湿度下启动吸湿，并在高湿度下保持大容量吸附。该设计超越了传统流水线工作，通过金属配位环境调控水分吸附行为，无需引入盐类脱水剂即可实现宽湿度窗口内的吸湿性能。IHHs的吸湿起始点接近零RH，且在高RH下仍能维持显著的吸湿能力，同时具备可逆循环特性。这种设计基于协调化学原理，通过调节pH值控制配位微环境和网络结构，从而影响水分吸附动力学。实验与模拟结果表明，Zn中心的配位环境作为早期水合位点，其动态变化决定了水分在凝胶中的分布与演化。该研究为开发无盐类的吸湿水凝胶提供了新思路，并展示了如何通过分子层面的设计实现材料性能的优化。

fields.en: The intrinsic hygroscopic hydrogels (IHHs) proposed in this paper achieve hygroscopic initiation at low relative humidity and maintain high capacity adsorption at high humidity through molecular self-assembly regulated by pH. The core lies in the coordination environment of the Zn center as an early hygroscopic site, where pH regulation controls the network structure and water absorption behavior. This material achieves hygroscopic performance over a wide humidity range without the need for salt precipitation, providing new insights for the design of salt-free hygroscopic hydrogels.

fields.en: This paper reveals the moisture absorption behavior and dynamic evolution mechanism of intrinsic hygroscopic hydrogels (IHHs) constructed through metal-ligand synergistic interactions under pH control. Future research can further investigate the impact of coordinated microenvironments under different pH conditions on water adsorption kinetics, as well as how to utilize these coordinated structures to optimize the moisture response characteristics of hydrogels. Additionally, molecular dynamics simulations can be used to explore the role of zinc center coordination environments in the early moisture absorption process and to verify their stability and reproducibility in practical applications.
fields.zh: 本文揭示了通过pH调控的金属-配体协同作用构建的内在吸湿水凝胶（IHHs）在湿度范围内的吸湿行为与动态演化机制。未来可进一步研究不同pH条件下的协调微环境对水分吸附动力学的影响，以及如何利用这些协调结构优化水凝胶的吸湿响应特性。此外，可通过分子动力学模拟探索Zn中心配位环境在早期吸湿过程中的作用机制，并验证其在实际应用中的稳定性与可重复性。

decisions.focus: Ion compensation-assisted photolithography enables high-resolution electrolytes for neuromorphic transistors

The article presents a novel ion compensation-assisted photolithography (ICAP) strategy that addresses the critical challenge of resolving the trade-off between patterning resolution, ionic capacitance, and operational stability in miniaturized electrolytes for organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs). The ICAP method enables high-resolution, high-capacitance, and stable electrolyte patterns through a combination of UV-triggered dual crosslinking and post-patterning ion replenishment. This approach allows for the precise patterning of electrolytes in OECT arrays, significantly improving their performance by enhancing the on/off ratio and suppressing inter-device crosstalk. The method is broadly compatible with various semiconductor materials, demonstrating its versatility across organic and inorganic systems.

离子补偿辅助光刻（ICAP）技术通过结合紫外触发的双交联与后图案化离子补充步骤，实现了高分辨率的电解质图案化。该方法在2微米的空间分辨率下，实现了15.6 μF cm−2 的电容和超宽温度范围（-50至200°C）下的稳定性。ICAP技术能够有效隔离阵列中的离子传输，减少横向离子泄漏和设备间串扰。通过ICAP工艺，可以兼容p型PEDOT:PSS、n型苯并咪唑苯并菲烯以及无机WO3等多种材料系统，为高密度电解质门器件提供了灵活的图案化策略。该技术在有机电化学晶体管（OECT）中应用时，显著提升了开启/关闭比和抑制了设备间串扰。ICAP方法不仅解决了图案分辨率、离子电容和操作稳定性之间的长期权衡问题，还为神经形态电子学提供了可行的高密度、晶圆级混合集成OECT电子解决方案。

ICAP技术的关键设计在于解耦传统电解质图案化中通常不兼容的两个需求：光刻过程中的精确结构定义与高移动离子含量以实现有效的电解质门控。通过开发一种光刻前驱体（PLE），在紫外照射下形成耐溶剂的物理化学双交联网络，该网络允许准确的光刻图案化同时保持最小的膨胀。随后的离子补偿步骤补充了固定光刻后的可移动离子，提高了电解质电容而不损害结构完整性。ICAP方法实现了高分辨率、高电容和高稳定性的电解质图案化。

实验结果表明，ICAP技术能够有效提升OECT性能，包括开启/关闭比的显著提高和设备间串扰的有效抑制。该技术在多种材料系统中表现出良好的兼容性，包括有机半导体和无机氧化物半导体。通过TCAD模拟验证了ICAP策略在高密度集成中的可行性，并且其水基开发、无光刻胶的方法避免了对活性半导体的损伤，确保了广泛材料系统的适用性。

综上所述，ICAP技术为高密度、大规模集成的OECT器件提供了可行的解决方案。该方法不仅解决了传统电解质图案化中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的权衡问题，还通过双交联与离子补偿机制实现了结构精度与电化学性能的平衡，为神经形态电子学的发展奠定了基础。
items.research_logic: 作者提出ICAP假说，通过结合紫外双交联与后图案化离子补充步骤，解决电解质图案化中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的矛盾。首先，通过光刻胶制备了具有溶剂抵抗性的物理交联网络，确保图案精度的同时保持结构稳定。随后，通过离子补偿步骤补充移动离子，提升电容而不破坏结构完整性。该策略实现了2 μm空间分辨率和15.6 μF cm−2的电容，验证了其在极端温度下的稳定性。综述分析通过TCAD模拟比较不同电解质配置，确认ICAP策略在有机和无机半导体中的广泛兼容性。每一步设计均确保结构精度与电化学性能平衡，避免对活性半导体造成损伤，从而实现高密度集成。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，ICAP策略通过结合紫外双交联与后图案化离子补充步骤，实现了高分辨率电解质的精准制备，解决了微小电解质中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的长期矛盾。该方法在保持结构完整性的同时提升了电化学性能，适用于多种材料系统，为高密度神经形态电子器件提供了可扩展的解决方案。其核心原理是通过物理交联网络增强结构稳定性，并利用离子补偿维持高电容，这一机制可迁移至其他需要高精度图案化与稳定电性能的领域，如柔性电子和生物传感器。
items.selection_reason: ICAP策略通过结合紫外双交联与后图案化离子补充步骤，实现了高分辨率电解质的精准制备。该方法在保持结构完整性的同时提升了电解质的电容性能，解决了传统电解质图案化中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的矛盾。ICAP技术能够实现2 μm的空间分辨率和15.6 μF cm−2的电容，且在-50至200 °C的宽温范围内保持稳定。该策略兼容多种材料系统，包括p型PEDOT:PSS、n型BBL和无机WO3，为高密度电解质门控器件和神经形态电子提供了可扩展的平台。ICAP技术通过避免额外光刻胶和干蚀刻步骤，实现了水性开发和电阻自由的制备方式，有效保护了活性半导体材料，确保了广泛材料兼容性。
items.application_prospects: ICAP技术在电解质图案化中展现出广阔的应用前景，能够实现高分辨率（2 μm）和高电容（15.6 μF cm−2）的电解质，适用于神经形态电子器件。其通过紫外双交联与后处理离子补充步骤，实现了结构稳定性与电化学性能的平衡，兼容多种材料系统，包括有机和无机半导体。该技术可有效解决高密度集成中的离子泄漏和交叉干扰问题，为大规模集成电路提供可行方案。
items.future_directions: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何利用ICAP策略优化电解质图案化以实现更宽温度范围内的稳定性能？此外，ICAP在不同材料系统中的兼容性是否能进一步扩展以适应更多类型的半导体？通过TCAD模拟和实验验证，可以探索ICAP对高密度神经形态电子器件的潜在影响。

fields.en:
Ion Compensation Assisted Patterning (ICAP) technology achieves high-resolution electrolyte patterning by combining ultraviolet-triggered dual-crosslinking with a post-patterned ion supplementation step. The method achieves a capacitance of 15.6 μF cm−2 at a spatial resolution of 2 micrometers and demonstrates stability over an ultra-wide temperature range (-50 to 200°C). ICAP technology effectively isolates ion transport within the array, reducing lateral ion leakage and device-to-device crosstalk. Through the ICAP process, compatibility with multiple material systems, including p-type PEDOT:PSS, n-type benzimidazole benzo[f]thiophene, and inorganic WO3, is achieved, providing a flexible patterning strategy for high-density electrolyte gate devices. When applied to organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs), ICAP significantly improves the on/off ratio and suppresses device-to-device crosstalk. The ICAP method not only resolves the long-standing trade-off between patterning resolution, ion capacitance, and operational stability but also provides a feasible high-density, wafer-level hybrid integrated OECT electronic solution for neurosynaptic electronics.

The key design of the ICAP technology lies in decoupling two typically incompatible requirements in traditional electrolyte patterning: precise structural definition during lithography and high mobile ion content to achieve effective electrolyte gate control. By developing a precursor for lithography (PLE), a solvent-resistant physical and chemical dual-crosslinked network is formed under ultraviolet irradiation, which allows accurate lithographic patterning while maintaining minimal expansion. Subsequent ion compensation steps replenish the mobile ions after fixed lithography, enhancing the electrolyte capacitance without compromising structural integrity. The ICAP method achieves high-resolution, high-capacitance, and high-stability electrolyte patterning.

The experimental results show that the ICAP technology can effectively enhance the performance of OECTs, including significant improvement in the on/off ratio and effective suppression of inter-device crosstalk. The technology exhibits good compatibility with various material systems, including organic semiconductors and inorganic oxide semiconductors. TCAD simulations have verified the feasibility of the ICAP strategy in high-density integration, and its water-based development without photoresist avoids damage to active semiconductors, ensuring wide applicability across various material systems.

In summary, the ICAP technology provides a feasible solution for high-density, large-scale integrated OECT devices. This method not only resolves the trade-off between resolution, capacitance, and stability in traditional electrolyte patterning, but also achieves a balance between structural precision and electrochemical performance through dual crosslinking and ion compensation mechanisms, laying the foundation for the development of neurosynaptic electronics.

paragraphs.en: In summary, the ICAP technology provides a feasible solution for high-density, large-scale integrated OECT devices. This method not only resolves the trade-off between resolution, capacitance, and stability in traditional electrolyte patterning, but also achieves a balance between structural precision and electrochemical performance through dual crosslinking and ion compensation mechanisms, laying the foundation for the development of neurosynaptic electronics.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，ICAP技术为高密度、大规模集成的OECT器件提供了可行的解决方案。该方法不仅解决了传统电解质图案化中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的权衡问题，还通过双交联与离子补偿机制实现了结构精度与电化学性能的平衡，为神经形态电子学的发展奠定了基础。

fields.en: The author proposed the ICAP hypothesis, which addresses the contradiction between resolution, capacitance, and stability in electrolyte patterning by combining ultraviolet dual crosslinking with a post-patterned ion supplementation step. First, a physically crosslinked network was prepared using a photoresist to ensure pattern accuracy while maintaining structural stability. Subsequently, moving ions were supplemented through an ion compensation step to enhance capacitance without compromising structural integrity. This strategy achieved a 2 μm spatial resolution and a capacitance of 15.6 μF cm−2, verifying its stability under extreme temperatures. A review analysis compared different electrolyte configurations using TCAD simulations, confirming the wide compatibility of the ICAP strategy in both organic and inorganic semiconductors. Each design step ensures a balance between structural precision and electrochemical performance, avoiding damage to active semiconductors, thereby enabling high-density integration.
fields.zh: 作者提出ICAP假说，通过结合紫外双交联与后图案化离子补充步骤，解决电解质图案化中分辨率、电容和稳定性之间的矛盾。首先，通过光刻胶制备了具有溶剂抵抗性的物理交联网络，确保图案精度的同时保持结构稳定。随后，通过离子补偿步骤补充移动离子，提升电容而不破坏结构完整性。该策略实现了2 μm空间分辨率和15.6 μF cm−2的电容，验证了其在极端温度下的稳定性。综述分析通过TCAD模拟比较不同电解质配置，确认ICAP策略在有机和无机半导体中的广泛兼容性。每一步设计均确保结构精度与电化学性能平衡，避免对活性半导体造成损伤，从而实现高密度集成。

fields.en: My conclusion is that the ICAP strategy achieves precise preparation of high-resolution electrolytes by combining ultraviolet dual crosslinking with a post-patterned ion supplementation step, resolving the long-standing contradiction between resolution, capacitance, and stability in small electrolytes. The method enhances electrochemical performance while maintaining structural integrity, making it applicable to various material systems and providing a scalable solution for high-density neurosynaptic electronic devices. Its core principle is to enhance structural stability through a physical crosslinking network and maintain high capacitance via ion compensation. This mechanism can be transferred to other fields requiring high-precision patterning and stable electrochemical performance, such as flexible electronics and biosensors.

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The ICAP strategy achieves precise preparation of high-resolution electrolytes by combining ultraviolet dual-crosslinking with a post-patterning ion supplementation step. This method enhances the electrocapacitive performance of the electrolyte while maintaining structural integrity, resolving the contradiction among resolution, capacitance, and stability in traditional electrolyte patterning. The ICAP technology can achieve a spatial resolution of 2 μm and a capacitance of 15.6 μF cm−2, remaining stable over a wide temperature range from -50 to 200 °C. This strategy is compatible with multiple material systems, including p-type PEDOT:PSS, n-type BBL, and inorganic WO3, providing an scalable platform for high-density electrolyte-gated devices and neuromorphic electronics. The ICAP technology achieves aqueous development and resistance-free preparation by avoiding additional photoresist and dry etching steps, effectively protecting active semiconductor materials and ensuring broad material compatibility.

fields.en: The ICAP technology shows broad application prospects in electrolyte patterning, enabling high-resolution (2 μm) and high capacitance (15.6 μF cm−2) electrolytes suitable for neuromorphic electronic devices. It achieves a balance between structural stability and electrochemical performance through ultraviolet dual crosslinking and post-processing ion supplementation steps, and is compatible with various material systems, including organic and inorganic semiconductors. The technology can effectively address issues of ion leakage and crosstalk in high-density integration, providing a feasible solution for large-scale integrated circuits.
fields.zh: ICAP技术在电解质图案化中展现出广阔的应用前景，能够实现高分辨率（2 μm）和高电容（15.6 μF cm−2）的电解质，适用于神经形态电子器件。其通过紫外双交联与后处理离子补充步骤，实现了结构稳定性与电化学性能的平衡，兼容多种材料系统，包括有机和无机半导体。该技术可有效解决高密度集成中的离子泄漏和交叉干扰问题，为大规模集成电路提供可行方案。

fields.en: This paper proposes testable future questions: How can the ICAP strategy be used to optimize the patterning of electrolytes to achieve stable performance over a wider temperature range? Additionally, is the compatibility of ICAP with different material systems further expandable to accommodate more types of semiconductors? Through TCAD simulations and experimental verification, the potential impact of ICAP on high-density neuromorphic electronic devices can be explored.

decisions.focus: Mutations in the CSF1R tyrosine-kinase domain underlie the white matter disease of HDLS, establishing HDLS as a microglial disorder

The study identifies CSF1R mutations as the genetic basis for HDLS, establishing a link between microglial dysfunction and white matter disease. The findings suggest that CSF1R mutations lead to partial loss of function in microglial signaling, which may contribute to neurodegeneration. This work provides a novel insight into the role of microglia in neurological disorders and highlights the importance of CSF1R in brain health.

classification_audit.abstract: Hereditary diffuse leukoencephalopathy with spheroids (HDLS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited central nervous system white matter disease with variable clinical presentations including personality and behavioral changes, dementia, depression, parkinsonism, seizures, and others 1 , 2 . We combined genome-wide linkage analysis with exome sequencing and identified 14 different mutations affecting the tyrosine kinase domain of the colony stimulating factor receptor 1 (encoded by CSF1R ) in 14 families affected by HDLS. In one kindred, the de novo occurrence of the mutation was confirmed. Follow-up sequencing analyses identified an additional CSF1R mutation in a patient clinically diagnosed with corticobasal syndrome (CBS). In vitro , CSF-1 stimulation resulted in the rapid autophosphorylation of selected tyrosine-residues in the kinase domain of wild-type but not mutant CSF1R, suggesting that HDLS may result from a partial loss of CSF1R function. Since CSF1R is a critical mediator of microglial proliferation and differentiation in the brain, our findings suggest an important role for microglial dysfunction in HDLS pathogenesis.

items.action:
HDLS是一种常染色体显性遗传的中枢神经系统白质疾病，其临床表现多样，包括行为、认知和运动变化。研究发现，CSF1R基因的酪氨酸激酶域突变是导致HDLS的主要原因，这些突变影响了微胶质细胞的功能，从而引发疾病。通过全外显子测序和基因组连锁分析，研究人员在14个家庭中发现了14种不同的CSF1R突变，并证实其中一种突变为新发突变。此外，在一名临床诊断为皮质基底节综合征（CBS）的患者中也发现了另一种CSF1R突变。体外实验显示，CSF-1刺激导致野生型CSF1R的快速自磷酸化，而突变体则没有这种现象，表明HDLS可能是由于CSF1R功能部分丧失引起的。CSF1R是大脑微胶质细胞增殖和分化的重要介质，因此这些发现支持了微胶质细胞功能障碍在HDLS发病机制中的作用。研究还指出，CSF1R突变筛查可能有助于准确诊断HDLS，并促进对预症状个体的检测，这对于治疗开发和早期治疗至关重要。此外，这些发现也为理解其他成人起病的白质病变提供了新的视角，并提示HDLS可能与其他疾病如色素性全色性白质营养不良（POLD）属于同一临床病理实体。

研究进一步揭示了CSF1R突变在微胶质细胞中的作用机制。突变导致CSF1R激酶活性丧失，可能形成非功能性的同源二聚体或野生型/突变异源二聚体，从而引发显性负效应。此外，这些突变还可能影响微胶质细胞的信号传导，进而影响白质病变的发生发展。

研究还探讨了CSF1R在其他疾病中的潜在作用，如Nasu-Hakola病（NHD），该病由DAP12/TREM2蛋白复合物的隐性功能丧失突变引起。尽管NHD和HDLS都涉及微胶质细胞功能障碍，但两者的病理机制可能有所不同。研究认为，HDLS和NHD可能共享部分信号通路，但具体的分子机制仍需进一步探索。

综上所述，CSF1R基因的突变是HDLS的重要遗传基础，这些发现不仅有助于理解微胶质细胞在白质病变中的作用，也为其他神经退行性疾病的研究提供了新的思路。
items.research_logic: 作者通过基因组连锁分析和外显子测序识别了14种影响CSF1R酪氨酸激酶域的突变，确立HDLS与微胶质细胞功能障碍的关系。为验证假说，作者在体外研究了CSF-1对野生型和突变型CSF1R的自磷酸化作用，发现突变型CSF1R无法自磷酸化，提示部分CSF1R功能丧失可能引起HDLS。为进一步排除替代解释，作者分析了HDLS患者与正常人CSF1R表达水平及磷酸化状态，未发现显著差异，但考虑到HDLS患者为杂合子，体内实验条件与体外不同，因此无法完全排除自磷酸化异常。综述中通过比较不同疾病患者的CSF1R突变情况，确认了HDLS与微胶质细胞功能障碍的关联，并指出未来研究应关注CSF1R信号通路在神经退行性疾病中的作用。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，CSF1R基因突变导致HDLS的机制可能通过部分丧失CSF1R功能引起微胶质细胞异常，这一机制可迁移至其他与微胶质细胞功能相关的神经退行性疾病研究中。但该机制仅适用于微胶质细胞功能异常导致的白质病变，不适用于其他病理过程。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过基因组学和外显子测序技术，首次明确HDLS是由CSF1R基因突变引起的遗传性疾病。该研究发现CSF1R基因的突变导致微胶质细胞功能异常，进而引发白质病变。研究不仅确定了HDLS的遗传基础，还揭示了微胶质细胞在神经退行性疾病的潜在作用。此外，研究通过体外实验验证了CSF1R突变对信号传导的影响，为理解微胶质细胞在神经系统疾病中的功能提供了新视角。这些发现有助于未来针对微胶质细胞功能障碍的治疗策略开发，并可能拓展到其他白质病变的研究中。
items.application_prospects: 本文揭示了CSF1R基因突变在HDLS中的致病作用，表明其可能作为微胶质细胞功能障碍的标志。该研究为理解白质疾病提供了新视角，并提示未来可探索CSF1R信号通路在神经退行性疾病中的作用。然而，由于未发现直接治疗应用证据，因此不建议将其用于药物或抑郁症领域。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可聚焦于CSF1R信号通路在HDLS及其他微胶质细胞疾病中的作用机制，探索其在白质病变中的具体功能及调控方式。此外，针对CSF1R突变的筛查和分子机制研究可能有助于鉴别其他神经退行性疾病患者，并为早期诊断和治疗提供依据。

fields.en:
HDLS is an autosomal dominant central nervous system leukodystrophy with diverse clinical manifestations, including behavioral, cognitive, and motor changes. Research has found that mutations in the tyrosine kinase domain of the CSF1R gene are the main cause of HDLS, as these mutations affect the function of microglia, thereby causing the disease. Through whole-exome sequencing and genome linkage analysis, researchers identified 14 different CSF1R mutations in 14 families and confirmed that one of them is a de novo mutation. Additionally, another CSF1R mutation was found in a patient clinically diagnosed with corticobasal syndrome (CBS). In vitro experiments showed that CSF-1 stimulation caused rapid autophosphorylation of wild-type CSF1R, while mutants did not exhibit this phenomenon, indicating that HDLS may be due to partial loss of function of CSF1R. CSF1R is an important mediator for the proliferation and differentiation of microglia in the brain, so these findings support the role of microglial dysfunction in the pathogenesis of HDLS. The study also highlights that CSF1R mutation screening may help in accurate diagnosis of HDLS and facilitate detection of presymptomatic individuals, which is crucial for drug development and early treatment. Furthermore, these findings provide new insights into understanding other adult-onset leukodystrophies and suggest that HDLS may belong to the same clinical-pathological entity as other diseases such as polycystic leukoencephalopathy (POLD).

The study further reveals the mechanism of action of CSF1R mutations in microglia. Mutations leading to loss of CSF1R kinase activity may result in the formation of non-functional homodimers or wild-type/mutant heterodimers, thereby inducing dominant negative effects. In addition, these mutations may affect the signaling of microglia, thereby influencing the development and progression of white matter lesions.

The study also explored the potential role of CSF1R in other diseases, such as Nasu-Hakola disease (NHD), which is caused by recessive loss-of-function mutations in the DAP12/TREM2 protein complex. Although both NHD and HDLS involve dysfunction of microglia, their pathogenic mechanisms may differ. The study suggests that HDLS and NHD may share some signaling pathways, but the specific molecular mechanisms remain to be further investigated.

In summary, mutations in the CSF1R gene are an important genetic basis for HDLS, and these findings not only help understand the role of microglia in white matter lesions but also provide new insights for research on other neurodegenerative diseases.

paragraphs.zh: 研究还探讨了CSF1R在其他疾病中的潜在作用，如Nasu-Hakola病（NHD），该病由DAP12/TREM2蛋白复合物的隐性功能丧失突变引起。尽管NHD和HDLS都涉及微胶质细胞功能障碍，但两者的病理机制可能有所不同。研究认为，HDLS和NHD可能共享部分信号通路，但具体的分子机制仍需进一步探索。

paragraphs.en: In summary, mutations in the CSF1R gene are an important genetic basis for HDLS, and these findings not only help understand the role of microglia in white matter lesions but also provide new insights for research on other neurodegenerative diseases.

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study, through genomic and exome sequencing technologies, first clearly identified HDLS as a genetic disorder caused by mutations in the CSF1R gene. The study found that mutations in the CSF1R gene lead to dysfunction of microglia, which in turn causes white matter lesions. The study not only determined the genetic basis of HDLS but also revealed the potential role of microglia in neurodegenerative diseases. Additionally, the study verified through in vitro experiments the impact of CSF1R mutations on signal transduction, providing a new perspective on the function of microglia in neurological disorders. These findings will help develop future treatment strategies targeting microglial dysfunction and may extend to other studies on white matter lesions.
fields.zh: 本研究通过基因组学和外显子测序技术，首次明确HDLS是由CSF1R基因突变引起的遗传性疾病。该研究发现CSF1R基因的突变导致微胶质细胞功能异常，进而引发白质病变。研究不仅确定了HDLS的遗传基础，还揭示了微胶质细胞在神经退行性疾病的潜在作用。此外，研究通过体外实验验证了CSF1R突变对信号传导的影响，为理解微胶质细胞在神经系统疾病中的功能提供了新视角。这些发现有助于未来针对微胶质细胞功能障碍的治疗策略开发，并可能拓展到其他白质病变的研究中。

fields.en: This paper reveals the pathogenic role of CSF1R gene mutations in HDLS, indicating that it may serve as a marker for microglial dysfunction. The study provides a new perspective on understanding white matter diseases and suggests future exploration of the CSF1R signaling pathway's role in neurodegenerative diseases. However, since no direct therapeutic application evidence was found, it is not recommended for use in drug or depression fields.

Additionally, screening for CSF1R mutations and molecular mechanism studies may help identify patients with other neurodegenerative diseases and provide a basis for early diagnosis and treatment.

decisions.focus: Copper regulates rest-activity cycles through the locus coeruleus-norepinephrine system

The study identifies a critical role for copper in regulating rest-activity cycles and arousal through the locus coeruleus-norepinephrine (LC-NE) system, establishing a molecular axis involving copper transporters CTR1, ATP7A, and DBH that is essential for LC function. The work provides direct evidence of copper's influence on neuromodulatory circuits and highlights the importance of metal homeostasis in neural function.

classification_audit.abstract: The unusually high demand for metals in the brain along with insufficient understanding of how their dysregulation contributes to neurological diseases motivates the study of how inorganic chemistry influences neural circuitry. We now report that the transition metal copper is essential for regulating rest–activity cycles and arousal. Copper imaging and gene expression analysis in zebrafish identifies the locus coeruleus-norepinephrine (LC-NE) system, a vertebrate-specific neuromodulatory circuit critical for regulating sleep, arousal, attention, memory and emotion, as a copper-enriched unit with high levels of copper transporters CTR1 and ATP7A and the copper enzyme dopamine beta-hydroxylase (DBH) that produces NE. Copper deficiency induced by genetic disruption of ATP7A, which loads copper into DBH, lowers NE levels and hinders LC function as manifested by disruption in rest–activity modulation. Moreover, LC dysfunction caused by copper deficiency from ATP7A disruption can be rescued by restoring synaptic levels of NE, establishing a molecular CTR1-ATP7A-DBH-NE axis for copper-dependent LC function.

items.action:
铜在调节休息-活动周期和觉醒中的作用通过去甲肾上腺素系统得以体现。研究发现，铜是维持该神经回路的关键元素，其作用机制涉及铜转运蛋白CTR1、ATP7A以及铜依赖性酶DBH的协同作用。通过斑马鱼模型，研究人员利用荧光探针和激光诱导耦合等离子体质谱技术，证实了铜在神经元突触中的富集分布，并揭示了铜缺乏导致去甲肾上腺素水平下降、LC功能受损的现象。进一步研究显示，ATP7A基因的遗传破坏会导致脑内铜含量减少，从而影响LC-NE系统功能，而通过恢复突触中去甲肾上腺素水平可逆转这一现象。此外，LC神经元中CTR1、ATP7A和DBH的表达高度集中，表明这些分子靶点在维持LC功能中的关键作用。实验还发现，LC是大脑中铜含量最高的区域，且其功能受损会导致休息-活动周期紊乱。综上所述，铜通过调控LC-NE系统，在维持觉醒和睡眠行为中发挥核心作用。

研究进一步揭示了铜在神经回路中的分子机制：CTR1负责铜的摄入，ATP7A参与铜的转运与金属蛋白的金属化过程，而DBH则催化去甲肾上腺素的合成。这些分子共同构成了一个铜依赖性的LC功能轴，确保了LC-NE系统对觉醒和行为调节的正常运作。实验数据表明，LC是维持该系统的必要组成部分，其功能受损会导致休息-活动周期紊乱。

综上所述，本研究通过斑马鱼模型揭示了铜在调控神经回路中的关键作用，特别是在维持觉醒和睡眠行为方面。研究结果为理解金属元素在神经系统发育与功能中的作用提供了新的视角，并强调了维持铜稳态对于正常脑功能的重要性。
items.research_logic: 作者通过铜在脑中的分布和功能研究，提出铜通过LC-NE系统调节休息-活动周期的假说。首先利用荧光探针和LA-ICP-MS分析铜在脑神经元中的富集，发现铜主要分布在神经突触和脑室区域，而非细胞体，为后续研究提供基础证据（p5, p8）。接着通过基因敲除ATP7A导致铜缺乏，观察到LC功能受损，NE水平下降，验证了铜对LC-NE系统的依赖性（p9, p10）。进一步通过药物干预降低脑铜水平，发现行为异常与铜缺乏相关，支持铜维持昼夜节律和睡眠的必要性（p13, p14）。最后通过激光消融实验确认LC细胞缺失导致休息-活动周期紊乱，证明LC在铜依赖调节中的关键作用（p15, p18）。综述分析通过比较不同实验数据，如铜分布、基因表达、行为变化等，系统论证了铜通过LC-NE轴调控神经功能的机制。每一步验证均基于具体实验数据，排除替代解释，确保结论可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期，其机制依赖于铜转运蛋白CTR1、ATP7A和DBH的协同作用。该实验设计表明，在研究神经回路中金属元素的作用时，应优先关注特定脑区的金属分布与功能关联性，并结合分子成像与基因表达分析验证金属依赖性神经调控机制。此原则适用于探索其他金属在神经系统中的作用，但需注意其适用边界为特定物种和发育阶段。
items.selection_reason: 铜通过去甲肾上腺素系统调节休息-活动周期，这一发现揭示了铜在神经回路中的关键作用。研究利用斑马鱼模型，结合铜成像和基因表达分析，证实了LC-NE系统作为铜富集单元的重要性。铜缺乏导致NE水平下降，影响LC功能，进而破坏休息-活动调控。通过恢复突触NE水平可逆转此现象，建立CTR1-ATP7A-DBH-NE轴，证明铜依赖的LC功能。该研究超越常规流水线工作，基于具体实验设计和机制，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。
items.application_prospects: 本文揭示铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期，其应用前景在于理解金属在神经回路中的作用机制。实现条件需结合铜成像与基因表达分析，约束包括铜运输和酶活性的特异性分布。铜 deficiency影响NE合成及LC功能，提示铜在维持觉醒和睡眠行为中关键。该研究为金属依赖性神经调控提供了分子基础，对脑发育和疾病治疗有潜在价值。
items.future_directions: 本文研究揭示铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期和觉醒行为，未来可进一步探索铜在神经回路中的具体作用机制及铜稳态对昼夜节律的影响。例如，可设计实验验证不同铜浓度对LC功能的调节效应，并利用计算模型预测铜运输蛋白与NE合成之间的分子交互。

fields.en:
The role of copper in regulating the rest-activity cycle and arousal is manifested through the norepinephrine system. Research findings show that copper is a key element for maintaining this neural circuit, with its mechanism involving the synergistic action of copper transporters CTR1, ATP7A, and copper-dependent enzymes DBH. Using a zebrafish model, researchers confirmed the enrichment distribution of copper in neurons' synapses through fluorescent probes and laser-induced coupling plasma mass spectrometry, revealing that copper deficiency leads to decreased levels of norepinephrine and impaired function of the LC. Further studies showed that genetic disruption of the ATP7A gene reduces copper levels in the brain, thereby affecting the function of the LC-NE system, while restoring norepinephrine levels in synapses can reverse this phenomenon. Additionally, the expression of CTR1, ATP7A, and DBH in LC neurons is highly concentrated, indicating that these molecular targets play a critical role in maintaining LC function. The experiment also found that the LC is the region in the brain with the highest copper content, and its functional impairment leads to disturbances in the rest-activity cycle. In conclusion, copper plays a core role in maintaining arousal and sleep behavior by regulating the LC-NE system.

The study further reveals the molecular mechanisms of copper in neural circuits: CTR1 is responsible for copper uptake, ATP7A participates in copper transport and metalation of metalloproteins, while DBH catalyzes the synthesis of norepinephrine. These molecules together constitute a copper-dependent locus coeruleus (LC) functional axis, ensuring the normal operation of the LC-NE system in regulating arousal and behavior. Experimental data show that the LC is a necessary component for maintaining the system, and its dysfunction leads to disturbances in the rest-activity cycle.

In summary, this study reveals the critical role of copper in regulating neural circuits, particularly in maintaining wakefulness and sleep behavior through the zebrafish model. The findings provide new insights into the role of metal elements in nervous system development and function, and emphasize the importance of maintaining copper homeostasis for normal brain function.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that copper regulates the rest-activity cycle through the LC-NE system by studying its distribution and function in the brain. First, using fluorescent probes and LA-ICP-MS to analyze copper enrichment in brain neurons, it was found that copper is mainly distributed in synaptic areas and ventricular regions, not in cell bodies, providing foundational evidence for subsequent research (p5, p8). Next, by knocking out ATP7A to induce copper deficiency, the dysfunction of LC and reduced NE levels were observed, verifying the dependency of the LC-NE system on copper (p9, p10). Further, through drug intervention to lower brain copper levels, behavioral abnormalities were found to be related to copper deficiency, supporting the necessity of copper in maintaining circadian rhythms and sleep (p13, p14). Finally, by confirming the loss of LC cells through laser ablation, it was demonstrated that the absence of LC cells leads to disruption of the rest-activity cycle, proving the critical role of LC in copper-dependent regulation (p15, p18). The review analyzes by comparing different experimental data, such as copper distribution, gene expression, and behavioral changes, systematically arguing the mechanism by which copper regulates neural function through the LC-NE axis. Each step of verification is based on specific experimental data, excluding alternative explanations, ensuring the reliability of the conclusions.

paragraphs.zh: 作者通过铜在脑中的分布和功能研究，提出铜通过LC-NE系统调节休息-活动周期的假说。首先利用荧光探针和LA-ICP-MS分析铜在脑神经元中的富集，发现铜主要分布在神经突触和脑室区域，而非细胞体，为后续研究提供基础证据（p5, p8）。接着通过基因敲除ATP7A导致铜缺乏，观察到LC功能受损，NE水平下降，验证了铜对LC-NE系统的依赖性（p9, p10）。进一步通过药物干预降低脑铜水平，发现行为异常与铜缺乏相关，支持铜维持昼夜节律和睡眠的必要性（p13, p14）。最后通过激光消融实验确认LC细胞缺失导致休息-活动周期紊乱，证明LC在铜依赖调节中的关键作用（p15, p18）。综述分析通过比较不同实验数据，如铜分布、基因表达、行为变化等，系统论证了铜通过LC-NE轴调控神经功能的机制。每一步验证均基于具体实验数据，排除替代解释，确保结论可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that copper regulates the rest-activity cycle through the LC-NE system, and its mechanism depends on the synergistic action of copper transporters CTR1, ATP7A, and DBH. This experimental design suggests that when studying the role of metal elements in neural circuits, attention should be paid to the distribution and functional correlation of metals in specific brain regions, and the metal-dependent neuroregulatory mechanisms can be verified through molecular imaging and gene expression analysis. This principle applies to exploring the role of other metals in the nervous system, but it is important to note that its applicability is limited to specific species and developmental stages.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期，其机制依赖于铜转运蛋白CTR1、ATP7A和DBH的协同作用。该实验设计表明，在研究神经回路中金属元素的作用时，应优先关注特定脑区的金属分布与功能关联性，并结合分子成像与基因表达分析验证金属依赖性神经调控机制。此原则适用于探索其他金属在神经系统中的作用，但需注意其适用边界为特定物种和发育阶段。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: Copper regulates the rest-activity cycle through the norepinephrine system, revealing its critical role in neural circuits. The study utilized a zebrafish model, combining copper imaging and gene expression analysis, to confirm the importance of the LC-NE system as a copper-rich unit. Copper deficiency leads to decreased NE levels, affecting LC function and disrupting rest-activity regulation. Restoring synaptic NE levels can reverse this phenomenon, establishing the CTR1-ATP7A-DBH-NE axis, proving copper-dependent LC function. This study goes beyond conventional pipeline work, based on specific experimental design and mechanisms, without fabricating a global first or journal-determined excellence.
fields.zh: 铜通过去甲肾上腺素系统调节休息-活动周期，这一发现揭示了铜在神经回路中的关键作用。研究利用斑马鱼模型，结合铜成像和基因表达分析，证实了LC-NE系统作为铜富集单元的重要性。铜缺乏导致NE水平下降，影响LC功能，进而破坏休息-活动调控。通过恢复突触NE水平可逆转此现象，建立CTR1-ATP7A-DBH-NE轴，证明铜依赖的LC功能。该研究超越常规流水线工作，基于具体实验设计和机制，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。

fields.en: This paper reveals that copper regulates the rest-activity cycle through the LC-NE system, with application prospects in understanding the mechanisms of metals in neural circuits. The implementation conditions require combining copper imaging with gene expression analysis, constraints include the specific distribution of copper transport and enzyme activity. Copper deficiency affects NE synthesis and LC function, suggesting that copper is critical for maintaining wakefulness and sleep behavior. This study provides a molecular basis for metal-dependent neural regulation, with potential value for brain development and disease treatment.
fields.zh: 本文揭示铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期，其应用前景在于理解金属在神经回路中的作用机制。实现条件需结合铜成像与基因表达分析，约束包括铜运输和酶活性的特异性分布。铜 deficiency影响NE合成及LC功能，提示铜在维持觉醒和睡眠行为中关键。该研究为金属依赖性神经调控提供了分子基础，对脑发育和疾病治疗有潜在价值。

fields.en: This study reveals that copper regulates the rest-activity cycle and arousal behavior through the LC-NE system. Future research could further explore the specific mechanisms of copper in neural circuits and its impact on circadian rhythms. For example, experiments could be designed to verify the regulatory effects of different copper concentrations on LC function, and computational models could be used to predict molecular interactions between copper transport proteins and NE synthesis.
fields.zh: 本文研究揭示铜通过LC-NE系统调控休息-活动周期和觉醒行为，未来可进一步探索铜在神经回路中的具体作用机制及铜稳态对昼夜节律的影响。例如，可设计实验验证不同铜浓度对LC功能的调节效应，并利用计算模型预测铜运输蛋白与NE合成之间的分子交互。

decisions.focus: Unveiling the Potential of p-Block Bismuth in Homogeneous Electrocatalytic Proton Reduction: Secondary Coordination Sphere Control of Catalytic Activity

The study presents a pioneering exploration of p-block bismuth in homogeneous electrocatalytic proton reduction, focusing on the control of catalytic activity through secondary coordination sphere effects. The research demonstrates how ligand design can significantly influence redox cycling and catalytic performance, offering new insights into main-group metal electrocatalysis. The findings establish foundational principles for designing redox-active main-group catalysts and highlight the potential of p-block redox chemistry in practical applications.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract The development of sustainable hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) based on earth-abundant molecular electrocatalysts requires strategies that enable controlled access to reactive low-valent intermediates while overcoming conventional activity-overpotential scaling relationships. Although transition metal complexes have been extensively explored, the potential of main-group systems remains largely untapped due to challenges in stabilizing reactive low-valent states and the lack of predictive catalyst design frameworks integrating electronics, geometry, and secondary sphere effects. Herein, we report a series of NCN pincer-supported Bi­(III) organometallic catalysts [(L 1 )­BiCl 2 ] (1) , [(L 2 )­BiCl 2 ] (2) , [(L 3 )­BiCl 2 ] (3) , [(L 4 )­BiCl 2 ] (4) , [(L 5 )­BiCl 2 ] (5) , [(L 6 )­BiCl 2 ] (6) , [(L 7 )­BiCl 2 ] (7) ) that promote HER through in situ electrochemical access of active Bi­(I) intermediates. Mechanistic investigations combining potential–p K a analysis, Tafel slope measurements, in situ electrochemical studies, detailed electrokinetic study exploring foot-of-the-wave analysis (FOWA), controlled potential electrolysis, and density functional theory calculations support a Bi I /Bi III redox cycle-mediated proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) pathway involving transient bismuth hydride intermediates that are challenging to isolate under conventional chemical conditions. Systematic modulation of ligand electronics, geometry, and secondary coordination sphere features reveals a prominent role in modulating reactivity and further highlights that incorporation of a pendant − NH functionality acts as an intramolecular proton-assistance that significantly enhances catalytic activity, relative to analogues lacking pendant − NH proton functionality in the ligand backbone. Notably, secondary-sphere interactions from the ligand backbone enable these catalysts to circumvent traditional activity-overpotential scaling relationships, exhibiting enhanced performance at low overpotential that rivals state-of-the-art transition metal systems. These findings establish fundamental design principles for redox-active main-group electrocatalysis and expand the accessible redox space of the periodic table by leveraging p -block redox chemistry toward practical applications.

items.action:
研究聚焦于p-block生物素在均相电催化质子还原中的潜力，通过调控次级配位球效应来控制催化活性。论文提出了一系列NCN配体约束的红ox活性铋配合物作为HER催化剂，系统地调节了配体架构和红ox可及性，探讨了电子结构、几何约束和次级球设计对催化效率和机理路径的影响。这些研究建立了基础的设计原则，使p-block中心能够实现可逆的redox循环，并推动分子生物素作为主族能源相关电催化剂的可行平台。实验部分展示了配体合成与复杂物制备的过程，通过多种光谱技术进行表征。电化学研究显示，Bi III /Bi I红ox对介导的质子耦合电子转移（PCET）路径涉及瞬态生物素氢化物中间体，这些中间体在传统化学条件下难以隔离。系统调节配体的电子、几何和次级配位球特性揭示了其对反应性和选择性的显著影响，特别是引入 pendant -NH功能作为分子内质子辅助，显著增强了催化活性。此外，次级球相互作用使催化剂能够绕过传统的活性-过电势关系，表现出在低过电势下的高性能，与传统金属系统相当。这些发现为红ox活性主族电催化剂的设计提供了基础原则，并通过p-block红ox化学扩展了周期表中的可访问redox空间。

研究通过结合电化学分析、原位电化学研究、详细电动力学研究探索足部波分析（FOWA）、受控电势电解和密度泛函理论计算，支持Bi I /Bi III红ox循环介导的PCET路径。这些结果表明，次级球相互作用在小分子催化剂中对反应性和选择性有深远影响，通常揭示了之前不可访问的反应途径。论文还指出，主族金属电催化剂的设计需要考虑电子结构、几何约束和次级球设计的影响。

综上所述，该研究通过系统调节配体特性，成功开发出具有高催化活性的Bi(III)配合物，并展示了其在低过电势下表现出优异性能的能力。这些发现不仅为红ox活性主族电催化剂的设计提供了理论依据，也为实际应用中的能源相关电催化提供了新的思路和方法。
items.research_logic: 作者通过系统调节配体电子结构、几何约束和二次球设计，揭示了这些因素对催化效率和机理路径的显著影响。通过结合电化学研究、原位电化学分析、电动力学研究及DFT计算，验证了Bi I /Bi III 介导的质子耦合电子转移（PCET）途径，其中瞬时的双价铋氢化物中间体在常规化学条件下难以隔离。综述分析通过比较不同配体的电子特性、几何约束和二次球效应，强调了引入 pendant − NH 功能基团作为分子内质子辅助的重要性，显著提升了催化活性。同时，二次球相互作用使催化剂能够绕过传统活性-过电位关系，表现出在低过电位下的高性能，与过渡金属系统相当。这些发现为红ox-active 主族电催化剂设计提供了基础原理，并扩展了周期表中可访问的红ox空间。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过系统调节配体电子结构、几何约束和次级协调球设计，揭示了主族元素在电催化中的潜在应用价值。特别是，配体中引入的 pendant − NH 功能基团能够作为分子内质子辅助，显著提升催化活性，并且这种设计原则可以用于其他主族金属催化剂的开发，但需注意其适用性受限于次级协调球效应的调控能力。
items.selection_reason: 本文研究了基于p-block金属的生物素NCN手性配体支持的Bi(III)有机金属催化剂在均相电催化析氢反应中的应用，通过系统调节配体电子结构、几何约束和二次协调球效应，揭示了其对催化效率和机理路径的影响。实验发现，引入 pendant -NH 功能基团可作为分子内质子辅助，显著提升催化活性，且该催化剂能够绕过传统活性-过电势关系，表现出在低过电势下与过渡金属系统相当的性能。这些结果为p-block金属在能源相关电催化中的应用提供了基础设计原则，并扩展了周期表中可利用的氧化还原空间。
items.application_prospects: 本文研究了p-block生物在均相电催化析氢中的应用前景，通过调控配体电子结构、几何约束和次级配位球效应，实现了对催化活性的精准控制。实验表明，引入 pendant -NH 功能团可显著增强催化性能，且该体系能绕过传统活性-过电势关系，展现出在低过电势下与过渡金属系统相当的性能。这些发现为p-block元素在能源相关电催化中的应用提供了基础设计原则，并拓展了周期表中红ox空间的应用范围。
items.future_directions: 本文研究了p-block生物在均相电催化析氢中的潜力，通过调控配体电子结构、几何约束和次级配位球特性，揭示了其对催化效率和机理路径的影响。未来可进一步探索不同配体骨架中引入-NH基团对催化活性的增强机制，并验证次级配位球相互作用如何帮助催化剂绕过传统活性-过电势关系，实现低过电势下的高性能表现。

fields.en:
The study focuses on the potential of p-block biotin in homogeneous electrocatalytic proton reduction by controlling the secondary coordination sphere effects to regulate catalytic activity. The paper proposes a series of redox active bismuth complexes constrained by NCN ligands as HER catalysts, systematically regulating the ligand architecture and redox accessibility, exploring the impact of electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary coordination sphere design on catalytic efficiency and reaction pathways. These studies establish fundamental design principles enabling p-block centers to achieve reversible redox cycles and promoting molecular biotin as a viable platform for main group-related electrocatalysts. The experimental section demonstrates the synthesis of ligands and complex preparation processes, characterized by various spectroscopic techniques. Electrochemical studies show that the Bi III/Bi I redox pair mediating proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) pathways involve transient biotin hydride intermediates, which are difficult to isolate under conventional chemical conditions. Systematic regulation of ligand electronic, geometric, and secondary coordination sphere properties reveals their significant impact on reactivity and selectivity, particularly the introduction of pendant-NH functionalities as intramolecular proton assistance, significantly enhancing catalytic activity. Furthermore, interactions within the secondary sphere allow the catalyst to bypass the traditional active site-overpotential relationship, exhibiting high performance at low overpotentials comparable to conventional metal systems. These findings provide fundamental principles for designing redox-active main group electrocatalysts and extend the accessible redox space in the periodic table through p-block redox chemistry.

The study explores the foot-of-the-wave analysis (FOWA) through the integration of electrochemical analysis, in-situ electrochemical studies, detailed electrodynamics research, controlled-potential electrolysis, and density functional theory calculations, supporting the PCET pathway mediated by the Bi I/Bi III redox cycle. These results indicate that secondary sphere interactions have profound effects on reactivity and selectivity in small-molecule catalysts, often revealing previously inaccessible reaction pathways. The paper also highlights that the design of main-group metal electrocatalysts needs to take into account the influence of electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary sphere design.

In summary, this study successfully developed Bi(III) complexes with high catalytic activity by systematically regulating ligand properties, and demonstrated their excellent performance under low overpotentials. These findings not only provide theoretical basis for the design of redox active main group electrocatalysts but also offer new ideas and methods for energy-related electrocatalysis in practical applications.
fields.zh:
研究聚焦于p-block生物素在均相电催化质子还原中的潜力，通过调控次级配位球效应来控制催化活性。论文提出了一系列NCN配体约束的红ox活性铋配合物作为HER催化剂，系统地调节了配体架构和红ox可及性，探讨了电子结构、几何约束和次级球设计对催化效率和机理路径的影响。这些研究建立了基础的设计原则，使p-block中心能够实现可逆的redox循环，并推动分子生物素作为主族能源相关电催化剂的可行平台。实验部分展示了配体合成与复杂物制备的过程，通过多种光谱技术进行表征。电化学研究显示，Bi III /Bi I红ox对介导的质子耦合电子转移（PCET）路径涉及瞬态生物素氢化物中间体，这些中间体在传统化学条件下难以隔离。系统调节配体的电子、几何和次级配位球特性揭示了其对反应性和选择性的显著影响，特别是引入 pendant -NH功能作为分子内质子辅助，显著增强了催化活性。此外，次级球相互作用使催化剂能够绕过传统的活性-过电势关系，表现出在低过电势下的高性能，与传统金属系统相当。这些发现为红ox活性主族电催化剂的设计提供了基础原则，并通过p-block红ox化学扩展了周期表中的可访问redox空间。

研究通过结合电化学分析、原位电化学研究、详细电动力学研究探索足部波分析（FOWA）、受控电势电解和密度泛函理论计算，支持Bi I /Bi III红ox循环介导的PCET路径。这些结果表明，次级球相互作用在小分子催化剂中对反应性和选择性有深远影响，通常揭示了之前不可访问的反应途径。论文还指出，主族金属电催化剂的设计需要考虑电子结构、几何约束和次级球设计的影响。

综上所述，该研究通过系统调节配体特性，成功开发出具有高催化活性的Bi(III)配合物，并展示了其在低过电势下表现出优异性能的能力。这些发现不仅为红ox活性主族电催化剂的设计提供了理论依据，也为实际应用中的能源相关电催化提供了新的思路和方法。

fields.en: The authors reveal the significant impact of these factors on catalytic efficiency and reaction mechanisms through systematic regulation of ligand electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary sphere design. By combining electrochemical studies, in-situ electrochemical analysis, electrodynamics research, and DFT calculations, the Bi I/Bi III mediated proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) pathway is validated, where a transient divalent bismuth hydride intermediate is difficult to isolate under conventional chemical conditions. The review analysis emphasizes the importance of introducing pendant -NH functional groups as intramolecular proton helpers, which significantly enhances catalytic activity. Meanwhile, secondary sphere interactions allow the catalyst to bypass the traditional active site-overpotential relationship, demonstrating high performance at low overpotentials, comparable to transition metal systems. These findings provide fundamental principles for the design of redox-active main group electrocatalysts and expand the accessible redox space in the periodic table.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the potential application value of main group elements in electrocatalysis through systematic regulation of ligand electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary coordination sphere design. Particularly, the introduction of pendant -NH functional groups in the ligands can serve as intramolecular proton helpers, significantly enhancing catalytic activity. Moreover, this design principle can be applied to the development of other main group metal catalysts, but it should be noted that its applicability is limited by the control capability of the secondary coordination sphere effects.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过系统调节配体电子结构、几何约束和次级协调球设计，揭示了主族元素在电催化中的潜在应用价值。特别是，配体中引入的 pendant − NH 功能基团能够作为分子内质子辅助，显著提升催化活性，并且这种设计原则可以用于其他主族金属催化剂的开发，但需注意其适用性受限于次级协调球效应的调控能力。

fields.en: This study investigates the application of Bi(III) organometallic catalysts supported by biotin NCN chiral ligands based on p-block metals in homogeneous electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution reactions. By systematically regulating the electronic structure of the ligand, geometric constraints, and secondary coordination sphere effects, the influence of these factors on catalytic efficiency and reaction mechanisms is revealed. Experimental findings show that introducing pendant-NH functional groups can serve as intramolecular proton helpers, significantly enhancing catalytic activity. Moreover, this catalyst can bypass the traditional active site-overpotential relationship, demonstrating performance comparable to transition metal systems under low overpotentials. These results provide fundamental design principles for the application of p-block metals in energy-related electrocatalysis and expand the reducible oxidizable space in the periodic table.
fields.zh: 本文研究了基于p-block金属的生物素NCN手性配体支持的Bi(III)有机金属催化剂在均相电催化析氢反应中的应用，通过系统调节配体电子结构、几何约束和二次协调球效应，揭示了其对催化效率和机理路径的影响。实验发现，引入 pendant -NH 功能基团可作为分子内质子辅助，显著提升催化活性，且该催化剂能够绕过传统活性-过电势关系，表现出在低过电势下与过渡金属系统相当的性能。这些结果为p-block金属在能源相关电催化中的应用提供了基础设计原则，并扩展了周期表中可利用的氧化还原空间。

fields.en: This study explores the prospects of p-block biologies in homogeneous electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution. By regulating ligand electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary coordination sphere effects, precise control of catalytic activity is achieved. Experimental results show that introducing a pendant-NH functional group significantly enhances catalytic performance, and the system can bypass the traditional active site-overpotential relationship, demonstrating performance comparable to transition metal systems under low overpotentials. These findings provide fundamental design principles for the application of p-block elements in energy-related electrocatalysis and expand the application range of redox space in the periodic table.
fields.zh: 本文研究了p-block生物在均相电催化析氢中的应用前景，通过调控配体电子结构、几何约束和次级配位球效应，实现了对催化活性的精准控制。实验表明，引入 pendant -NH 功能团可显著增强催化性能，且该体系能绕过传统活性-过电势关系，展现出在低过电势下与过渡金属系统相当的性能。这些发现为p-block元素在能源相关电催化中的应用提供了基础设计原则，并拓展了周期表中红ox空间的应用范围。

fields.en: This study explores the potential of p-block biocatalysts in homogeneous electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution by regulating ligand electronic structure, geometric constraints, and secondary coordination sphere characteristics, revealing their impact on catalytic efficiency and reaction mechanisms. Future work could further investigate how introducing -NH groups into different ligand frameworks enhances catalytic activity, and verify how interactions within the secondary coordination sphere help catalysts bypass the traditional active site-overpotential relationship, achieving high performance under low overpotentials.
fields.zh: 本文研究了p-block生物在均相电催化析氢中的潜力，通过调控配体电子结构、几何约束和次级配位球特性，揭示了其对催化效率和机理路径的影响。未来可进一步探索不同配体骨架中引入-NH基团对催化活性的增强机制，并验证次级配位球相互作用如何帮助催化剂绕过传统活性-过电势关系，实现低过电势下的高性能表现。
